_about: Energy management system (EMS) costs, the same real price in every country (converted with params/fx.json). A country file params/ems/<country>.json may override them. Yearly fees and the fixed cost are deducted from the battery's yearly value in the sizing and the payback; the capex is added to the battery investment.
ancillary_fee_note: share of the yearly ancillary revenue paid to Voltiris (its EMS) and to an external company (aggregator)
savings_fee_note: share of the yearly saving on the electricity bill against the no-battery case (energy + peak savings, not ancillary), only when that saving is positive
capex_note: EMS hardware, bought once with the battery: 1,000 EUR = 917 CHF; not subsidised and not bought again at battery replacements
